caption: The drawing shows a partial view of a building featuring an ornate balcony with a decorative cast-lion or wrought-iron railing and support column. The scene is composed of geometric architectural elements, including a slanted wooden ceiling with visible planks, a balcony with vertically oriented bars joined by arched and floral motifs, and a slender column adorned with detailed floral ornamentation running vertically from the floor to the ceiling. Behind the balcony, there is a set of closed wooden shutters set within a rectangular frame, suggesting a doorway or window. The composition is rendered in tones of brown and beige, giving the image a monochromatic, sepia appearance. The structure and all of its elements are carefully outlined and shaded, highlighting the intricate details of the metalwork and woodwork. The entire image has a vertical orientation and is bordered by a plain, light-colored margin.
title: Cast Iron Balcony
